label: Config: Engine Settings (token length, conjuncts, ZWJ/ZWNJ)
logic_description: Declares engine-level constants: max_token_length (4), conjunct_support (true), zero_width_joiner (U+200D), zero_width_non_joiner (U+200C), assamese_ra (ৰ U+09F0), assamese_wa (ৱ U+09F1), virama (্ U+09CD), inherent_vowel ('o'). Referenced by all other snippets via config.*.

label: Pre-processing: Unicode NFC Normalisation
logic_description: Before any other processing, normalise the input string to Unicode NFC form. Required for correct multi-codepoint matching of Bengali-Assamese script characters (matras, virama, conjuncts). Applies to both forward and reverse directions.

label: Forward Pre: Reph Conjunctions (map-driven, all rX forms)
logic_description: Pre-parse substitution: for every consonant key in the forward map (sorted longest-first, skipping 'r' and 'rr'), build the compound key 'r'+roman and replace it with ৰ (U+09F0) + the consonant's BPM output. This covers all reph-prefixed conjuncts (rk, rth, rch, rng, rt, rng etc.) before the main loop sees them, bypassing reph-ligature logic entirely.

label: Forward Pre: Anusvara + Vowel Substitution (ng+vowel → ঙ+matra)
logic_description: Pre-parse: static substitution of ng+vowel sequences (ngOI, ngOU, ngaa, ngee, ngii, nguu, ngA, ngU, ngrri, ngai, ngO, nge, ngi, nga — longest-first) to ঙ (U+0999) + the corresponding matra Unicode, bypassing the anusvara path. Required because 'ng' maps to anusvara ং by default, which cannot carry a matra.

label: Forward Pre: Danda & Double Danda (.. → ॥, . → ।)
logic_description: Before the main loop, replace '..' with the double danda ॥ (U+0964 sequence) and '.' with the danda । (U+0964). Double danda must be substituted first so it is never split into two single dandas.

label: Forward Pre: Android Auto-cap Fix (inactive by default)
logic_description: If the first character of the input is uppercase but only its lowercase version exists in the forward map, lowercase it before processing. Disabled by default — enable only on Android keyboards that auto-capitalise the first character.

label: Forward Pre: Symbol / Punctuation Substitution (map-driven)
logic_description: Before the main loop, apply all entries from the forward punctuation map (longest-first) as plain string substitutions. Sourced from transliterator.js step 1. Runs after danda substitution (sort 10) so '..' and '.' are already converted and won't be double-processed.

label: Forward Pre: Latin Digit → Assamese/Bengali Digit
logic_description: Before the main loop, replace Latin digits 0–9 with their Assamese/Bengali equivalents using the forward digits map. Longest-first sort applied. Sourced from transliterator.js step 5 (numberRules).

label: Forward Pre: Unknown Character Passthrough Policy
logic_description: Policy marker: declares that unmatched characters in the forward direction pass through unchanged. No transformation is applied here. The main engine loop reads config.unknown_char_handling === 'passthrough'. Already set in config_engine_settings; this snippet serves as explicit documentation and override point.

label: Forward Loop: Reph Ligature — র + HALANTA + ZWJ (inactive)
logic_description: When 'r' appears before a non-doubled consonant, emit the reph + HALANTA + ZWJ to force a visible reph ligature above the following consonant. Disabled by default — enable only if the target font and rendering stack supports reph-ZWJ ligatures.

label: Forward Loop: Anusvara Revert Before Matra (ং → ঙ)
logic_description: When anusvara (ং U+0982) was the last emitted character and the current input token is a matra, revert the anusvara to ঙ (nga, U+0999) — a full consonant that can carry a dependent vowel sign. Required because 'ng' maps to anusvara by default but anusvara cannot anchor a matra.

label: Forward Loop: Y-fala Chaining (্য after consonant)
logic_description: When 'y' or 'Y' appears at the current position and the previous token was a consonant, emit virama + য (্য) as a ya-phala adjunct instead of an independent যঃ. Implements transliterator.js y/Y matra chaining. The matra map entry ['y','্য'] is the data source; this snippet provides the contextual prev.was_consonant guard.

label: Forward Loop: Digraph Cluster Prevention (inactive)
logic_description: Marks multi-character consonant keys (digraphs: kh, ch, ng, etc.) as was_digraph so the virama conjunct hook skips inserting a HALANTA after them. Disabled by default — enable only if digraph-after-consonant clusters are forming incorrectly.

label: Forward Loop: Passthrough — Unmatched Character Fallback
logic_description: Terminal fallback in the forward loop (transliterator.js step 6): if no rule has consumed the current position, emit the character as-is and advance one codepoint. Handles spaces, already-converted Unicode, ASCII punctuation not in the symbol map, and any other unrecognised input.

label: Reverse Pre: Strip Zero-Width Joiners (U+200D)
logic_description: First operation in reverse.js reverseTransliterate(): strip all Zero Width Joiner characters (U+200D) from the raw script input before any processing. ZWJs are rendering hints only and must be removed so conjunct detection and matra scanning work on clean codepoint sequences.

label: Reverse Pre: Unknown Character Passthrough Policy
logic_description: Policy marker: unmatched characters in the reverse direction pass through unchanged. No transformation applied. The engine loop reads config.unknown_char_handling === 'passthrough'. Already set in config_engine_settings; kept here for explicitness.

label: Reverse Loop: ZWNJ as Explicit Vowel Separator
logic_description: Implements reverse.js step 1 (ZWNJ handling): when a ZWNJ (U+200C) is encountered, check the last character of current output. If it already ends with a vowel (a e i o u O), swallow the ZWNJ silently. Otherwise emit uppercase 'O' to represent an explicit vowel break — mirroring the BM-IME apostrophe-matra → ZWNJ forward convention.

label: Reverse Loop: Reph Prefix (ৰ্<cons> → r+cons+phala+matra)
logic_description: Implements reverse.js step 2: when the sequence ৰ্ (Assamese Ra U+09F0 + Virama U+09CD) is found, peek ahead for a consonant, optional ya-phala/ra-phala, then a matra. Emit 'r' + consonant Roman + optional conjunct suffix ('y' or 'r') + matra Roman. Reconstructs all reph-prefix conjuncts (ৰ্ক→rk, ৰ্ক্য→rky, etc.).

label: Reverse Loop: Inherent Vowel Insertion after Consonant
logic_description: After a consonant has been emitted (state.prev.was_consonant = true), check if the next script character is a matra or virama. If neither, append the inherent vowel 'o' to the Roman output. This is the core of Assamese/Bengali schwa insertion in the reverse direction.

label: Reverse Loop: Schwa Deletion (consonant before consonant)
logic_description: In reverse direction: when a consonant is immediately followed by another consonant (no HALANTA between them), suppress the inherent vowel 'o' that was just appended by loopReverseInherentVowel. This implements the schwa deletion rule for BPM Roman output.

label: Reverse Loop: Standalone Reph (ৰ → r)
logic_description: In reverse direction: when the Assamese Ra ৰ (U+09F0) is encountered as a standalone character (not preceded by a virama — that case is handled by rev_loop_reph_prefix), emit 'r' and advance. Sets state.prev.was_consonant = true.

label: Reverse Loop: J-fala / Ya-phala (্য → y)
logic_description: In reverse direction: detect ya-phala sequences (্য = HASANT+য, U+09CD+U+09AF) and emit 'y' in Roman output, consuming the full two-codepoint sequence. The standalone য case is also consumed here when it appears as an adjunct. Clears state.prev.was_consonant.

label: Reverse Loop: R-fala / Ra-phala (্ৰ → r)
logic_description: In reverse direction: detect ra-phala sequences (্ৰ = HASANT+ৰ, U+09CD+U+09F0) and emit 'r' in Roman output, consuming the full two-codepoint sequence. Clears state.prev.was_consonant.

label: Reverse Loop: Open-O Matra Override (ো → O)
logic_description: In reverse direction: the matra ো (open-o, U+09CB) outputs uppercase 'O' rather than lowercase 'o' to distinguish it from the inherent vowel in Roman output. The post-processing protect-O snippet later converts this to lowercase 'o' after the punctuation-strip pass.

label: Reverse Loop: Assamese/Bengali Digit → Latin Digit
logic_description: Implements reverse.js step 3: map Assamese/Bengali digits ০–৯ (U+09E6–U+09EF) back to Latin 0–9 using the reverse digits map. Clears state.prev.was_consonant.

label: Reverse Loop: Script Punctuation → Latin (map-driven)
logic_description: Implements reverse.js step 4: scan the reverse punctuation map (longest-first) at the current position. On a match, emit the Latin equivalent and advance. Handles Danda (।→.), Double Danda (॥→..), and any other punctuation in the reverse map.

label: Reverse Loop: Independent Vowel → Roman
logic_description: Implements reverse.js step 5: match independent vowel characters (অ, আ, ই, ঈ, উ, ঊ, ঋ, এ, ঐ, ও, ঔ) at the current position using the reverse independent_vowels map, longest-first. Emit their Roman equivalents and advance. Clears state.prev.was_consonant.

label: Reverse Loop: Consonant + HASANT Conjunct (Case A)
logic_description: Implements reverse.js step 6 Case A: consonant followed by HASANT (্) + second consonant. Consumes HASANT, matches second consonant (য as second member = ya-phala → 'y'), detects optional ya-phala/ra-phala suffix, then looks for a trailing matra or assigns inherent 'o' if followed by another consonant. Emits: cons1_roman + cons2_roman + conjunct_suffix + matra_roman.

label: Reverse Loop: Consonant + Ya-phala (্য / Case B)
logic_description: Implements reverse.js step 6 Case B (ya-phala branch): consonant followed directly by ্য (HASANT+য). Emit consonant Roman + 'y'. Then check for a following matra — if present use it; if absent, default to 'O' (open-O inherent for ya-phala context). Advances past the ya-phala sequence and optional matra.

label: Reverse Loop: Consonant + Ra-phala (্ৰ / Case B)
logic_description: Implements reverse.js step 6 Case B (ra-phala branch): consonant followed directly by ্ৰ (HASANT+ৰ). Emit consonant Roman + 'r'. Then check for a following matra — if present use it; if absent, default to inherent 'o'. Advances past the ra-phala sequence and optional matra.

label: Reverse Loop: Consonant + Standard Matra or Inherent Vowel (Case C)
logic_description: Implements reverse.js step 6 Case C: standard consonant matched (longest-first from reverse consonants map), then scan for a dependent vowel matra at the next position. Emit consonant Roman + matra Roman. ো (open-O) emits 'O' via loopReverseOpenOMatra (sort 250), but this snippet also guards it. If no matra: append inherent 'o' only if followed by another consonant or vowel, not a symbol, and not in the SPECIAL_MODIFIERS set. Sets state.prev.was_consonant = true.

label: Reverse Loop: Fallback Passthrough (unmatched character)
logic_description: Terminal fallback in the reverse loop (reverse.js final fallback): if no map rule has consumed the current position, preserve the character as-is in the output and advance one codepoint. Handles characters outside the Assamese/Bengali Unicode block, spaces, and any unrecognised input.

label: Reverse Post: Protect Explicit 'O' During Punctuation Strip
logic_description: Implements utils.js phoneticTransform() steps 1–3: (1) replace all uppercase 'O' (explicit open-O matra) with placeholder 'PROTECT_O'; (2) strip trailing inherent 'o' before punctuation markers (. , ! ? ; ।); (3) restore 'PROTECT_O' back to lowercase 'o'. Ensures the punctuation-strip regex never destroys intentional open-O matras.

label: Reverse Post: Strip HASANT + Inherent-o Artifacts
logic_description: Implements utils.js phoneticTransform() step 4: remove broken conjunct remnants where a virama/HASANT (্) accidentally precedes an inherent vowel 'o' in the Roman output. These arise when a conjunct consonant is processed but its second member was not consumed correctly.

label: Reverse Post: Strip Trailing 'o' Before Punctuation
logic_description: Safety net pass: after rev_post_protect_explicit_o has run, perform a final strip of any remaining inherent 'o' that appears immediately before punctuation characters (. , ! ? ; ।). Handles edge cases where the protect pass may not have caught all instances.

label: Reverse Post: Lowercase Roman Output
logic_description: After all reverse transliteration is complete, lowercase the entire Roman output string. Implements utils.js phoneticTransform() step 5.

label: Reverse Post: Trim Whitespace
logic_description: Trim leading and trailing whitespace from the final Roman output. Implements utils.js phoneticTransform() step 5 (trim). Always runs last.
